name: Image Grid
description: Lay many pictures out as one sheet, in the order they are linked, with optional labels under each picture, above the columns and left of the rows. Pictures of different sizes are fitted into the largest size (never cropped) and centered. At most 64 pictures; a sheet over 16384 pixels on a side is an error.

inputs.name: images
inputs.label: Images
inputs.description: The pictures, left to right and top to bottom in the order of their links.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.label: Columns
inputs.description: 0 picks about a square (the square root of the count, rounded up).

inputs.name: labels
inputs.label: Labels
inputs.description: One line per picture, in order, written under it. Empty: no labels.

inputs.name: column_labels
inputs.label: Column labels
inputs.description: One line per column, written above it.

inputs.name: row_labels
inputs.label: Row labels
inputs.description: One line per row, written left of it.

inputs.name: gap
inputs.label: Gap
inputs.description: Pixels between pictures and around the sheet.

inputs.name: background
inputs.label: Background
inputs.description: The sheet's color. The labels are light on a dark one and dark on a light one.

inputs.name: label_size
inputs.label: Label size
inputs.description: The height of a label line in pixels. 0 is 3% of the picture height, at least 10.
